notes.title: 🎨 Dreampainters - The Journey Begins!
notes.content:
🖐️ Hello there!

My name is Xibuk, former House Flipper 2 game director and I'd like to tell you about my new project, Dreampainters. 
We are a small, passionate team strongly inspired by games such as Portal, Superliminal, and Viewfinder. Dreaming is a fascinating process, some people remember their fantasy while others only wish for it. We aim to create a title that immerses you in an amazing surrealistic world of dreams.

So what is Dreampainters about? It's a first-person game, where you travel through your dreams trying to solve puzzles using paints of different colors and abilities.



😉 Here’s a sneak peek of what we’re working on:

Spatial puzzles require mobility!
Bouncing yellow paint might help you with that:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469356/3071b322ee5930c25272c15da5a896bae61ef3d1.gif

Fear of the dark?
Fortunately, glowing purple paint will enlighten your way:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469356/6873a5667183276005e0b636ac6432f571729e7c.gif


Dreampainters is a work-in-progress project. Some aspects of the game may change during the development process. We’re very excited about the journey ahead of us! For more dev updates join us by adding Dreampainters to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479080/Dreampainters/


[hr][/hr]Oh! You're still here!
Seems like we're already gathering some fans! If you'd like to ask some questions or share any ideas, make sure to head to our Steam Discussions.

And remember,
Your dreams may change our world!
~ Stability Games
